lessonRef.subject: ready-for-life
lessonRef.title: Application or project: documents and questions

standardsRefs: Manuel Academy local Ready for Life composition
objective: I can complete a realistic documents and questions task, document the result with minimal private data, and revise a step that does not meet the lesson criteria.
scenario: A fictional character has an upcoming eye exam at Clearview Vision Center.

tasks.directions: Analyze the complete worked example on swk-rfl-g8-u04-l04-model-card before beginning.

prompts.text: Name the first move in the model and explain why it comes first.

tasks.directions: Complete the fictional coached case on swk-rfl-g8-u04-l04-guided-card, use criterion-specific feedback, and finish its fresh correction turn.

prompts.text: Name the move you completed and the success check it meets.

tasks.directions: Choose the permitted real-life route or complete fictional route on swk-rfl-g8-u04-l04-independent-card; follow every step and retain only the named minimal evidence.

prompts.text: Which complete route did you use?
Record the completed step numbers and one non-sensitive result statement.

tasks.directions: Complete the minimal evidence record on swk-rfl-g8-u04-l04-evidence-record; omit or fictionalize private details.

prompts.text: Which item on your ready-folder checklist would be easiest to forget the morning of a real appointment, and what could you do ahead of time to remember it?

remediation: Compare the missed move with the worked move on swk-rfl-g8-u04-l04-model-card; name one observable difference and review only the matching instruction step. Complete the affected move on swk-rfl-g8-u04-l04-guided-card with one coach prompt and receive feedback tied to the success check. Name the observable move that now meets the check and the one move, if any, that still needs correction. Do not use shame, trait, effort, or character judgments. Complete the same move on the fresh parallel condition in swk-rfl-g8-u04-l04-retry-pair without the coach prompt. Exit: The supported and parallel moves both meet the named success check: Document-category accuracy and genericness: Checklist lists at least three relevant document categories, each described generically (an ID card, an insurance card, and one more), with no real identifying numbers or names. | Question quality and topic variety: At least four original questions are written, covering at least three different topics, each with a short explanation of why it matters to ask. Resume at the next unfinished step on swk-rfl-g8-u04-l04-independent-card. A physical task resumes only with required permission and supervision; otherwise finish the equal-credit fictional route.
extension: Have the learner build a second ready-folder checklist for a different fictional appointment type, such as a fictional orthodontist consult, and compare which document categories repeat and which are new.

productionDepth.practicalGoal: I can complete a realistic documents and questions task, document the result with minimal private data, and revise a step that does not meet the lesson criteria.

duration.sessionPattern: 8–10 minutes model and planning, 8–10 minutes guided try, 20–30 minutes application, 7–10 minutes evidence and revision
duration.adultTime: No adult time required unless the learner chooses support

localMaterials.label: paper
localMaterials.availabilityRule: Use only when already available, safe, permitted, and appropriate. The complete fictional route replaces unavailable real-world access.

resources.title: documents and questions action steps
resources.purpose: Provides the ordered directions used by the model, guided attempt, independent task, and retry.
content: 1. Read the goal, constraints, and privacy boundary for documents and questions.
2. Analyze the worked model and identify why its sequence meets the criteria.
3. Complete the guided case and use feedback before moving on.
4. Select the permitted real-life route or the complete fictional route.
5. Carry out the task, retaining only the minimum evidence named in the record.
6. Compare the result with the success checks and complete the correction loop when needed.

resources.title: documents and questions coached first attempt
resources.purpose: Carries the complete first attempt and a fresh correction turn.
content: Fictional practice condition: A fictional character has an upcoming eye exam at Clearview Vision Center.
Coach direction: Brainstorm broadly before narrowing down to a checklist.
Learner prompt: Without looking ahead, name three general categories of documents you think any medical-type appointment front desk might ask a visitor to have ready.
Feedback check: name the move completed, point to the matching success check, and identify one missing or uncertain step without judging the learner.
Fresh correction turn: use the same fictional condition with one constraint changed; restate the changed constraint, redo only the affected step, and check the new result.

resources.title: documents and questions complete application
resources.purpose: Contains the lesson-specific application directions and prompts; it is the delivered card referenced by the learner flow.
content: Application direction: Build the ready-folder checklist for the fictional Clearview Vision Center visit using only general document categories, never real numbers or names.
Response 1 (t2-p1): I listed an ID card as a general document category, without writing any real ID number.
Response 2 (t2-p2): I listed an insurance card as a general document category, without writing any real insurance number.
Response 3 (t2-p3): Name one more general document category, besides an ID card and an insurance card, that this fictional eye appointment folder should include, and explain briefly why.
Equal-access rule: Use the fictional condition above and complete the same reasoning and evidence without private real-world details.

resources.title: documents and questions minimal evidence record
resources.purpose: Defines exactly what the learner saves and what must not be collected.
content: Record only: selected route, completed step numbers, one non-sensitive result statement, and one revision if a step changed.
Reflection: Which item on your ready-folder checklist would be easiest to forget the morning of a real appointment, and what could you do ahead of time to remember it?

Success checks: Document-category accuracy and genericness: Checklist lists at least three relevant document categories, each described generically (an ID card, an insurance card, and one more), with no real identifying numbers or names. | Question quality and topic variety: At least four original questions are written, covering at least three different topics, each with a short explanation of why it matters to ask.
Do not collect: names, signatures, addresses, or exact locations; account, identification, medical, product, or medicine details; photos, audio, video, passwords, or private household schedules.

resources.title: documents and questions supported and parallel retry cards
resources.purpose: Delivers a real correction loop rather than a direction to try again without support.
content: Contrast reteach: compare the model check on swk-rfl-g8-u04-l04-model-card with the missed or unsupported step; name the one observable difference.
Supported card: return to swk-rfl-g8-u04-l04-guided-card, complete the affected move with one coach prompt, and receive criterion-specific feedback.
Parallel card: use a fresh fictional documents and questions condition with one changed constraint; complete the same move without the coach prompt.

Exit check: the corrected move meets this lesson's checks — Document-category accuracy and genericness: Checklist lists at least three relevant document categories, each described generically (an ID card, an insurance card, and one more), with no real identifying numbers or names. | Question quality and topic variety: At least four original questions are written, covering at least three different topics, each with a short explanation of why it matters to ask..
Return: resume at the next unfinished step on swk-rfl-g8-u04-l04-independent-card; a physical route resumes only when the authorized adult says it is safe.

simulationRoute.title: documents and questions — complete fictional route
simulationRoute.directions: Complete the documents and questions task using the fictional condition and invented, non-sensitive details on the delivered independent card.
simulationRoute.completionCondition: Complete the same decision, procedure, evidence, and revision checks as the real-life route. No adult attests that a physical event occurred.

independentTask.privacyAlternative: The learner may use invented names, dates, amounts, organizations, spaces, and circumstances whenever real details are unnecessary or private.

learnerEvidence: one revision when a step changed
evidence.reflectionPrompt: Which item on your ready-folder checklist would be easiest to forget the morning of a real appointment, and what could you do ahead of time to remember it?
observableCriteria: Document-category accuracy and genericness: Checklist lists at least three relevant document categories, each described generically (an ID card, an insurance card, and one more), with no real identifying numbers or names.
Question quality and topic variety: At least four original questions are written, covering at least three different topics, each with a short explanation of why it matters to ask.

account, identification, medical, product, or medicine details
photos, audio, video, passwords, or private household schedules

retry.trigger: Start the correction loop when a required step is missing, the reason does not match the condition, a safety or privacy boundary is crossed, or the evidence does not show the stated result.
retry.targetedReteach: Compare the missed move with the worked move on swk-rfl-g8-u04-l04-model-card; name one observable difference and review only the matching instruction step.
retry.supportedReattempt: Complete the affected move on swk-rfl-g8-u04-l04-guided-card with one coach prompt and receive feedback tied to the success check.
retry.feedback: Name the observable move that now meets the check and the one move, if any, that still needs correction. Do not use shame, trait, effort, or character judgments.
retry.parallelReattempt: Complete the same move on the fresh parallel condition in swk-rfl-g8-u04-l04-retry-pair without the coach prompt.
retry.exitCriterion: The supported and parallel moves both meet the named success check: Document-category accuracy and genericness: Checklist lists at least three relevant document categories, each described generically (an ID card, an insurance card, and one more), with no real identifying numbers or names. | Question quality and topic variety: At least four original questions are written, covering at least three different topics, each with a short explanation of why it matters to ask.
retry.returnPath: Resume at the next unfinished step on swk-rfl-g8-u04-l04-independent-card. A physical task resumes only with required permission and supervision; otherwise finish the equal-credit fictional route.

guardianInvolvement.role: Optional coach only; no guardian attestation is required.
guardianInvolvement.signOffBoundary: A guardian attestation certifies only that the named physical event occurred. It never scores the learner reflection or proves effort, honesty, maturity, responsibility, diagnosis, or character.

safety.stopRule: Stop the physical route when permission, supervision, a safe setting, or an expected material is missing, or when a new hazard appears. Continue only when the authorized adult resolves it; otherwise use the complete fictional route.
safety.physicalBoundary: The learner follows the source safety notes and never performs adult-only handling, transport, account, legal, medical, heat, sharp-tool, electrical, chemical, or machine actions.
safety.noShameRule: Describe only the observable step, condition, evidence, or revision. Never label the learner, household, body, ability, effort, maturity, responsibility, or character.

privacy.rule: Collect the smallest process record that shows the lesson steps. A learner may choose fictional details and may decline private disclosure without losing credit.
doNotCollect: names, signatures, addresses, or exact locations
account, identification, medical, product, or medicine details
photos, audio, video, passwords, or private household schedules

may: coach the guided and retry cards
mayNot: observe or claim a physical condition
tutorBoundary.physicalCompletionRule: Tutor or AI may coach. Tutor or AI may not certify that a real-world physical action occurred.
tutorBoundary.missingResourceAction: Stop and name the unresolved resource. Do not fabricate it; use another complete delivered route only when every resource for that route resolves.
